As they played, Tom and Spot heard a loud noise. It was a big storm coming! Tom was scared, but Spot was not. They ran back down the mountain to get back to the house. The storm came, but the tree kept them safe.
Tom and Spot climbed down the mountain. They were safe now. They knew that Spot was a dependable dog who would always help them. From that day on, Spot and Tom always played and had fun together.
